digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate run summary & coverage reporting
propositions: Repeated LLM step call failures (non-fatal by design) are currently invisible in plan-review verdict JSON because they are swallowed and logged only as warnings without in-memory counters.
Empty LLM result arrays caused by all calls failing are byte-identical to empty arrays caused by no overlap, masking silent degradation from callers.
LLM calls funnel through a single seam (runner.py:573 except block) that records to JSONL spend log but not to the verdict verdict object.

A run-scoped contextvar sink (modeled on review_kernel/telemetry.py) must record failures at the runner seam, activate during plan-review gate run scope, and drain into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty to preserve attestation safety.
The drained coverage.llm_step_failures must be shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<call_label>: <int>}} and rendered by _render_plan_review_text without altering verdict, exit code, or signature.
Non-fatal failures are guaranteed by construction: only runs that survive the failure produce a verdict that reaches the drain, so no new failure mode or control flow change is needed.
